title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 4.87 (versions follow prime numbers; 487 after 479): Luma whole. Her house travels with the project (razar/luma-completa, 17 MB zipped, 415 MB open): her tongues' signatures, her tree of themes, her ways, forms, gears and creatures, with an index of what goes and what does not and why (nothing personal of her author). Also: their talk weighs more than her books when she talks; one reading room instead of a new one a book (she ran out of room numbers in ten minutes); her panel shows what she thinks. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v4.87: Luma completa. Prototipo de investigación.
